Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of neck and low back pain, consistent with
the mechanism of injury described. Initial evaluation documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical and lumbar
range of motion, which correlate with a soft tissue strain pattern. Neurological screening and several orthopedic provocation tests
were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical or lumbar regions is known to this office. Care consisted of
32 visits over the course of the treatment period, including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction.
The frequency of visits was reduced gradually as symptoms resolved and functional mobility improved, and the patient was
discharged to an independent home program. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, with no duplicated
charges.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
